name: NGC 7049 (Hubble)
blurb: NGC 7049, a giant galaxy on the border between spiral and elliptical, seen by Hubble.
label: ngc7049-hubble
story: An oddball giant galaxy, the brightest in its cluster, its core ringed by swirling lanes of dust and sprinkled with globular star clusters.

claims.text: NGC 7049 is a galaxy on the border between spiral and elliptical galaxies
NGC 7049 is the brightest galaxy of its cluster (Brightest Cluster Galaxy)
NGC 7049 has swirling dust lanes around its core and globular clusters; described as an oddball giant galaxy
